name: posthog-js-full-no-external
description: Subpath entry point for the bundle that inlines the extensions PostHog otherwise loads at runtime (session replay, surveys, logs, exception autocapture, tracing headers, web vitals and dead clicks) and ships no external script loader, the combination desktop apps and strict CSP sites need. What it does not inline — product tours, conversations, the toolbar and the chat integrations — does not load. Ships an ES module for bundlers and a CommonJS build for require. Types come from the canonical dist/module.d.ts: PostHog is a class with private members, so a duplicate declaration file would be a nominally incompatible type.
